styleLock.backgroundSystem: light green gradient #EFF6E6 to #DDECC9 throughout the set, with rounded cards #FFFFFF layered on top for infographic screens; hero and scene shots add a sunlit meadow with blurred foliage above light natural wood planks

styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; headlines in deep leaf green #2E7D32 or #FFFFFF on accent tags; body text dark green-grey #2F5233

styleLock.lockText: consistent natural herbal wellness ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of light green gradient background #EFF6E6 to #DDECC9, rounded cards #FFFFFF, deep leaf green #2E7D32, dark green-grey text #2F5233, and one warm orange accent #F07D00; bright natural daylight feel with soft diffused top-front key and gentle soft shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; consistent rounded rectangular label tags in the accent color with #FFFFFF label text; consistent thin-line square check marks and thin leader lines with small circular endpoints; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright product placement with consistent scale across the set and every canvas composed edge to edge by cards, tags and botanical elements; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 源为 800x8599 详情长图的 8 片高清切片（800x1200、重叠 60px），逐片实测拼合。实测有效屏 8 处：自然草甸首屏、四格状态自测、五效环拍注解（美容/免疫/气血/消化/抗辐射类主张一律不在图内写实渲染）、产品信息规格表、营养丰富/吸收率高/广泛使用三卡、草本配方清单、适用人群六圆、保存方法两步、品牌故事收口。合并：产品信息规格表与保存方法两步并为「规格保存指南」；三卡品质说明重映射为 TRUST。丢弃无信息区：产品展示空白画廊、二维码会员水印、未加载灰块；品牌故事含成立年份与行业地位等事实全部剥离。源无前后对比与多规格素材，故未设 COMPARISON/VARIANT，未作漏斗虚构补全。已剥离源图原文案、品牌字样、蝴蝶蜂鸟装饰与独特字体；产品一律 {product} 占位，资质与检测不在图内渲染、不虚构。
